You have [u]FULL[/u] control![/i]  [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Quality Of Life:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]UI Buttons now have reduced animation time.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tooltip causing lag in later waves now fixed[/p][/*][*][p]AI jittering or not knowing what to do near walls has now been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Game freeze - Have now been partially fixed - It's recommended to play the game in Fullscreen mode in wave 20+[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Known Issues:[/b][/h3][p][i]Issues that might still be in the game - need more debugging[/i][/p][list][*][p]On later waves enemies can sometimes get stuck on walls[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 1.3.9
notes.content: [p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342878/41b14d804a4f5621829bbe9b41a9568902b6de2f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Demo Update 1.3.9[/b][/h1][h1][/h1][h3][b]"A Visual Representation"[/b][/h3][p]With this update, both the steampage and the in game menus have received an updated visual coverart. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Balance Changes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Greedy Blob now starts with a "Blob Orb guaranteed to grant +1 gold on enemy death buff"[/p][/*][*][p]The boss now deals flat damage instead of player maxhealth percentage based damage[/p][p][i]It was not communicated in any way that the boss dealt damage based on the players max health. And a player choosing max hp enchantments would thus be punished for their choices. This have now been changed![/i][/p][/*][*][p]Gold pickup radius now increased![/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Quality Of Life:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Trashbin now shows the selling price of the upgrade you hold[/p][/*][*][p]Globs dropped auto collect after 5 seconds[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed visual bug with 4+ digit healthbar[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Reroll abuse and showing wrong price[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that allowed you to pause the game and collect coins when paused[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed so the game actually pauses during the boss cutscene[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual shield total block bug that displayed the wrong values.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Blob Beam Performance - Should now cause less lag in later waves[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Blob Aura tier 3 Performance - Should now cause less lag in later waves[/p][/*][*][p](hopefully) Fixed a bug when tabbing out and in to the game mid Game save causing the game to freeze / crash.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Known Issues:[/b][/h3][p][i]Issues that might still be in the game - need more debugging[/i][/p][list][*][p]Alt + Tab causing game to freeze crash - more common on dual screen setups?[/p][/*][*][p]On later waves enemies can sometimes get stuck on walls[/p][/*][*][p]Speed blob + ranged / beams can sometimes get stuck when surrounded by enemies - More likely to happened the more speed the character have[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: AutoBlobber Demo is Live!
notes.content:
[h1] 💥 AutoBlobber Demo is Now Available! 💥[/h1]

[b]Finally the AutoBlobber demo is live![/b]

Try the demo and see if you have what it takes to be the best "AutoBlobber" and climb the [u]global leaderboard[/u].

[h2]The Demo Contains[/h2]
[list]
[*]3 Starter Upgrades
[*]3 Unlockable Upgrades
[*]3 Unlockable Blob characters
[*]5 Enemy Types
[*]1 Boss Battle
[*]Global Leaderboard Support
[*]Endless Mode past Wave 15
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342878/864e8923081c88845b572226f184f5e063080cba.gif[/img]
this is just the start I'm actively working on the game and the final game will feature many more upgrades, blobs, enemies and bosses!

Try the demo, leave a review and wishlist the game if it's something for you!
